div.head: Copy of a report of a committee of the honorable the privy council, approved by his excellency the governor-general, on the 28 th September, 1878.
div.p: The committee have had under consideration the dispatch of Mr. Drummond, acting for Her Majesty’s minister at Washington, of 5th August, submitting certain amendments to the regulations governing the transportation of dutiable merchandise between Canada and the United States, for the consideration of this government.

The honorable the minister of customs reports that the regulations as contained in the circulars of the Secretary of the Treasury of September 15 and November 27, 1876, and the amendments, have proved satisfactory, in their practical operation, to this department, and he recommends that the same be approved and confirmed.
The committee advise that the regulations referred to be approved as recommended.
